Class CompanyRepresentative

java.lang.Object
Models.Entities.User
Models.Entities.CompanyRepresentative
public class CompanyRepresentative extends User
Represents a company representative in the Internship Placement Management System. Company representatives can create and manage internship opportunities, view applications, and manage application statuses for their internships.

Key features:

  • Can create up to 5 internship opportunities
  • Must be approved by Career Centre Staff before accessing the system
  • Can edit or delete only unapproved internships
  • Can view and manage applications for their internships
  • Can toggle visibility of their internships
Since:
2025-11-18

  • Constructor Details

    • CompanyRepresentative

      public CompanyRepresentative(String userId, String name, String email, String password, String companyName, String position, String department, String status)
      Constructs a new CompanyRepresentative instance. The new instance is immediately added to the static list allCompanyReps.
      Parameters:
      userId - The unique identifier for the representative.
      name - The full name of the representative.
      email - The email address of the representative.
      password - The password for the representative's account.
      companyName - The company the representative belongs to.
      position - The representative's job position.
      department - The representative's department.
      status - The initial authorization status of the account.

    • deleteInternship

      public boolean deleteInternship(Internship internship)
      Deletes an internship managed by this representative. Deletion is prevented if the internship has an "Approved" status.
      Parameters:
      internship - The Internship object to delete.
      Returns:
      true if the internship was successfully deleted; false otherwise.

    • editInternship

      public boolean editInternship(Internship internship)
      Edits an internship managed by this representative. Editing is prevented if the internship has an "Approved" status. Note: This method currently only performs validation and returns a boolean. The actual editing logic (e.g., changing fields) would occur after a successful return.
      Parameters:
      internship - The Internship object to edit.
      Returns:
      true if the internship is eligible for editing; false otherwise.

    • viewApplications

      public void viewApplications()
      Displays all applications submitted for every internship created by this representative. It utilizes the ApplicationViewer utility class.
